## Neutrino observatories {#icecube-future}

:::::: {.panel-tabset}

### IceCube

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**South Pole, Antarctic ice**

**IceCube:** $1\,\mathrm{km}^3$, operating.

**Upgrade:** 5 new strings, installed in 2026.

**Gen2:** $8\,\mathrm{km}^3$ optical array, proposed.

**Measurement:** more high-energy events; improved calibration and a radio extension.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/icecube-gen2-layout.png){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px;" fig-alt="Official visualization of the proposed IceCube-Gen2 expansion, including optical, surface and radio arrays around the existing IceCube detector."}

::: {.media-caption}
[Gen2 design illustration. DESY, Science Communication Lab.](https://icecube-gen2.wisc.edu/facility/detectors/)
:::
:::
:::::

### KM3NeT

[]{#km3net-arca-orca}

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**Mediterranean Sea**

**ARCA:** $\sim1\,\mathrm{km}^3$ for neutrino astronomy.

**ORCA:** $\sim7\,\mathrm{Mt}$ for neutrino oscillations.

**Full design:** 230 / 115 strings.

Construction and data taking.

**Measurement:** source searches with ARCA; oscillations with ORCA.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/km3net-artist-impression.jpg){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px;" fig-alt="Artist's impression from inside a KM3NeT building block on the sea floor: vertical detection units carrying spherical multi-PMT optical modules, the yellow buoy of a nearby unit, a close-up optical module and anchors on the seabed. An illustration, not a photograph."}

::: {.media-caption}
Artist's impression · [Edward Berbee/Nikhef · KM3NeT](https://www.km3net.org/pictures-and-videos/picture-galleries/album-artists-impressions/)
:::
:::
:::::

### Baikal-GVD

[]{#baikal-and-b-hunt}

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**Lake Baikal, fresh water**

**2026:** 16 clusters, operating.

**Reported effective volume:** $0.8\,\mathrm{km}^3$.

Modular growth through winter deployment.

**Measurement:** independent diffuse spectra and northern-site source searches.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/baikal-gvd-2026.jpg){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px; --media-bg: #fff;" fig-alt="Baikal-GVD's official 2026 configuration: sixteen numbered physics clusters, the separate experimental cluster, laser strings and deployment years. Original Russian labels are retained."}

::: {.media-caption}
[2026 configuration. Baikal-GVD.](https://baikal-gvd.jinr.ru/telescope)
:::
:::
:::::

### P-ONE

[]{#p-one}

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**Pacific Ocean, British Columbia**

**Full design:** $\sim1\,\mathrm{km}^3$, 70 strings.

- Ocean Networks Canada's NEPTUNE infrastructure.
- Prototype and deployment engineering.

**Measurement:** neutrino astronomy from another northern ocean site.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/p-one-configuration.jpg){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px; --media-bg: #fff;" fig-alt="P-ONE collaboration illustration of seven planned clusters and a ten-string cluster with kilometre-long mooring lines. This is a design drawing, not a deployed full detector."}

::: {.media-caption}
[Proposed configuration. K. Holzapfel / P-ONE.](https://www.pacific-neutrino.org/p-one/)
:::
:::
:::::

### TRIDENT

[]{#chinese-projects}

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**South China Sea**

**Design:** $7.5\,\mathrm{km}^3$, 1,211 strings.

**Sensors:** hybrid PMT + SiPM modules.

R&D and pathfinder programme.

**Design goal:** photon timing and directional information from hybrid sensors.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/trident-layout.png){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px; --media-bg: #fff;" fig-alt="TRIDENT's proposed Penrose-tiling array layout from figure 2 of Ye et al. Black points mark strings, red triangles junction boxes, dashed paths allow ROV maintenance, with a 500 metre scale bar."}

::: {.media-caption}
[Proposed layout. Ye et al., Nature Astronomy (2023), Fig. 2.](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41550-023-02087-6)
:::
:::
:::::

### HUNT

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**China + Russia**

**Design:** $\sim30\,\mathrm{km}^3$.

**Sensors:** 20-inch PMTs.

The Baikal option, B-HUNT, is the next slide.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/hunt-design.jpg){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px;" fig-alt="Official HUNT concept illustration showing large single-PMT optical modules on underwater strings. This is a design illustration, not a photograph of an operating array."}

::: {.media-caption}
[Design illustration. HUNT / IHEP, CAS.](https://ihep.cas.cn/astro/en/research/sf/ucp/202510/t20251011_7986821.html)
:::
:::
:::::

### NEON

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
**South China Sea**

**Design:** $10\,\mathrm{km}^3$, 1,200 strings.

**Sensors:** multi-PMT optical modules.

Proposal and hardware R&D.

**Design goal:** high-energy source searches with a large multi-PMT array.
:::
::: {.column width="61%"}
![](media/observatories/neon-layout.png){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 560px;" fig-alt="NEON's proposed Fibonacci-spiral string layout and multi-PMT module from the upper panel of figure 3 in Zhang et al. The illustration includes the original 1,790 metre radius and 1,000 metre height labels."}

::: {.media-caption}
[Proposed layout. Zhang et al., Fig. 3.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.05122)

## Baikal-GVD → B-HUNT {#b-hunt}

:::::: {.panel-tabset}

### From GVD to B-HUNT

![](media/prospects/gvd-to-bhunt.svg){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-width: 1450px; --media-max-height: 580px;" fig-alt="Milestones: 2024 first HUNT prototype string in Lake Baikal with 12 modules of 20-inch photomultipliers; 2025 a full-scale string with 20-inch modules operating in Lake Baikal, and four prototype detector units with an LED calibration unit at 1600 metres in the South China Sea; 2026 Baikal-GVD with 16 clusters and about 0.8 cubic kilometres effective volume; about 2028 Baikal-GVD at about 1 cubic kilometre; about 2040 B-HUNT at about 30 cubic kilometres. Two cubes of 1 and 30 cubic kilometres are drawn to volume scale."}

::: {.media-caption}
Russia + China · Baikal-GVD Collaboration with IHEP (Beijing) · [JINR (2026)](https://www.jinr.ru/posts/grigory-trubnikov-baikal-gvd-neutrino-telescope-to-reach-1-km-sup-3-sup-volume-by-2028/) · [IHEP](https://ihep.cas.cn/astro/en/research/sf/ucp/202510/t20251011_7986821.html)
:::

### Why Baikal?

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="47%"}
**The ice is a platform:** strings are deployed from the frozen lake every winter.

**Water:** light scatters less than in ice, so cascade directions are sharper.

**Northern site:** the Galactic Centre is below the horizon $75\%$ of the day.

**A gamma-ray partner:** LHAASO watches the same northern sky.

Alerts and follow-up: work in progress.
:::
::: {.column width="49%"}
![](media/observatories/hunt-design.jpg){.slide-media .nostretch style="--media-max-height: 520px;" fig-alt="Official HUNT concept illustration showing large single-PMT optical modules on underwater strings. This is a design illustration, not a photograph of an operating array."}

::: {.media-caption}
[Design illustration. HUNT / IHEP, CAS.](https://ihep.cas.cn/astro/en/research/sf/ucp/202510/t20251011_7986821.html)
:::
